meta.title: Wolter Invest — physical assets, monthly profit share, clear numbers
meta.description: We provide bikes and power for couriers. You fund the equipment and receive a monthly share of the profit. We take care of day-to-day operations.

site.heroDesc: We provide bikes and power for couriers. You fund the equipment and receive a monthly share of the profit. We take care of day-to-day operations.
site.heroDisclosure: We pay your share of actual profit in UZS. We do not guarantee returns. Our proposed term is 48 months; early exit is not guaranteed.
site.rewardNote: We show USD equivalents. Our calculation assumes unchanged operating profit.
site.benefit1Text: Under our proposed lease, the equipment stays in your name for the lease term.
site.benefit2Text: Our team manages riders, rentals and routine maintenance.
site.benefit3Title: A share of profit, every month
site.benefit3Text: We show distributable profit and your share in our monthly reporting.
site.howEyebrow: 01 / WHAT YOUR CAPITAL PUTS TO WORK
site.howDesc: We bring e-bike rental and battery swapping together in one network. Your investment funds one cluster with the equipment below.
site.cabinetDesc: A battery exchange point in our network.
site.bikeDesc: The vehicles we rent to delivery riders.
site.batteryDesc: We plan for 1.5 batteries per bike.
site.stream1Text: We rent electric bikes to couriers and earn revenue from their rental payments.
site.stream2Text: We earn revenue from our battery service through subscriptions or payments per use.
site.flowTitle:
Know your share.
At every stage.
site.flowDesc: We offer a 48-month partnership. The agreements we sign together define our respective rights and responsibilities.
site.phase1Text: We allocate 70% of distributable net profit to you and 30% to us.
site.phase2Text: We allocate 30% of distributable net profit to you and 70% to us.
site.phaseEndText: Our model transfers the assets to us at the end of month 48. Before signing, clarify with us what happens if your capital has not been recovered.
site.sharedNote: We cover operating expenses from revenue, which affects your profit share. Review responsibilities for wear, major maintenance and insurance with us in the contracts.
site.evidenceTitle:
Our results,
open for you to see.
site.evidenceDesc: Here we share our 2026 revenue, our May pilot and the investor calculation. We explain the period and basis behind each set of figures.
site.pilotNote: These are the user counts in our admin panel for our May 2026 pilot. Active and inactive are statuses in our dashboard. We have not specified the activity window or criteria here.
site.modelTitle: How do we calculate your share?
site.modelDesc: We share the starting figures in our financial model. We do not provide an independent audit opinion for this calculation.
site.modelExplain: We normalize swap revenue to 30 days and divide it across 14 model clusters. We scale rental revenue from a base of 200 bikes to 14 bikes in a new cluster. We deduct the cost percentages before sharing profit.
site.modelLimits: We hold profit flat for 48 months in this calculation. We exclude additional replacement costs, investor taxes, delays and exchange-rate changes. We increase the input ratio of 10 bikes per cabinet to 14 in a new cluster.
site.risksDesc: Your ownership and our responsibilities are set out in the agreement. We track your equipment and manage daily operations to keep it in working condition.
site.risk1Title: How is your profit share determined?
site.risk1Text: We pay your share from the actual net profit of our operations. The calculation applies a 70% share until capital recovery and 30% thereafter. Results depend on revenue and costs: profit may fall or be zero. We do not guarantee returns or capital recovery; some or all of your capital may be lost.
site.risk2Text: We pay in UZS; the dollar equivalent depends on the exchange rate. The partnership term is 48 months. Review the agreement’s provisions for the end of the term and early exit. We do not guarantee an early sale or exit.
site.risk3Text: Equipment ownership, use and our duties as operator are fully set out in the agreement. We track each unit, monitor its technical condition and organize servicing. Keeping the equipment in working condition is our team’s daily responsibility.
site.risk4Text: Our partnership follows the Ijarah / Ijarah Muntahia Bittamleek lease model. Our lease structure is established and our legal opinion is ready. We already work with partners on this basis. Review our agreement and legal opinion before making your decision.
site.teamNote: Meet our Wolter team and advisors. Our advisors’ involvement does not guarantee your capital or returns.
site.ctaTitle:
Let’s look at
the numbers together.
site.ctaDesc: Get in touch. We can discuss our financial model, partnership terms and your questions together. Contacting us does not commit you to invest.
site.docNote: Review our agreement, legal opinion and your partnership questions with our team.
site.footerAbout: We keep couriers supplied with bikes and power. We invite you to partner with our network.
site.footerLegal: GETNOW LLC (Wolter) · Tashkent, Uzbekistan. Here we explain our proposed asset-based lease partnership. We are not selling company equity; this is not a public offering of securities. Our calculations are illustrative and we do not guarantee returns or capital recovery.
site.raisedText: Raised from our partners under this lease structure.
site.risk3Care: If equipment develops a fault, we take all necessary steps to restore its operation. Technical downtime is possible; our obligations and how we fulfil them are defined in the agreement.
site.legalCta: Request the agreement and legal opinion ↗

calc.title:
Choose your investment.
Understand your returns.
calc.desc: Choose your cluster count and our model will calculate your monthly share and illustrative 48-month cash flows. We also show the assumptions behind the numbers.
calc.scenarioNote: We apply −15% / 0% / +15% to net profit. We have not assigned probabilities to these scenarios.
calc.stressNote: 0% means no profit; 100% is our base calculation. Use this to explore a drop in profit; we are not predicting future results.
calc.noPhase2: Phase 2 is not reached within 48 months
calc.gainNote: Before additional investor costs and taxes.
calc.chartDesc: The capital line marks your initial investment; the chart is not the asset’s market value.
calc.irrNote: IRR accounts for cash-flow timing. It is not a fixed annual payment or a guaranteed rate.
calc.note: This is our illustrative calculation. We pay in UZS and use an assumed rate of 1 USD = 12,000 UZS for USD display, not a live rate. We hold profit flat for 48 months. We do not guarantee full capital recovery or early exit.
calc.limits: We exclude additional maintenance/replacements, investor taxes, delays and FX changes. We scale results in proportion to cluster count and change the share in the month after capital recovery.
